comments.author: TheReviewerWildTake
comments.body:
Tell your AI to chill with overloading backgrounds. It is one of those fields where you have to police some AIs hard.  
  
And don\`t use such bright colors on the frame.  
 Eyes should naturally follow visual flow to the center of attention, but they get "stuck" on infinite loop of looking at the frames and ultra bright mana numbers.

comments.author: Fuzzzy420
comments.body:
Way to much detail in the cards. 
Try this: tell the ai to use a detail budget. 10% background, 10% border and 80% for the main attraction.
